caption: The drawing depicts a tall, rectangular grandfather clock with a wooden case in varying shades of brown. The clock has a curved, ornate top with carved details, and the body is divided into three main sections. The upper section houses the clock face, which is circular with a white background, black Roman numerals, and black clock hands. Above the clock face, there is a decorative arch containing floral patterns in soft colors such as red, blue, and green. The central section of the clock features a narrow, vertical door with a glass panel, behind which a brass pendulum is visible. The door has a small round gold or brass handle. The lower part of the clock is solid wood with a rectangular raised panel. The drawing is set on an off-white background and outlined with a faint pencil border.
title: Clock
